description: This file contains styles for a Tic Tac Toe web game, defining the layout and appearance of various components such as the game board, squares, and controls.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main styling for the application, centering the content and applying the primary background color.

classes.name: game-title
classes.description: Styling for the main title of the game, including color and font size.

classes.name: game-container
classes.description: Styles for the container holding the game elements, centered and vertically aligned.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Grid layout for the game board, defining the grid structure and visual appearance.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Styling for individual squares of the game board, including size, color, and hover/active states.

classes.name: game-controls
classes.description: Styles for the container holding the game control buttons, arranging them in a column.

classes.name: control-button
classes.description: Base styling for buttons used in game controls, including padding and hover effects.

classes.name: game-status
classes.description: Styling for displaying the current status of the game, including win messages.

classes.name: win-message
classes.description: Styles for the message displayed when a player wins the game.
